metadata.description: The BLOCKS collection is built on top of the BTC block data with onchain 3D bitfeed representations, inscribed on block-matching uncommon sats, and created with parent-child provenance. BLOCKS•OF•BITCOIN shall be used for growing the BLOCKS ecosystem into 3D worlds with digital assets. A genesis BLOCKS inscription (Gen-0) must have a valid Bitmap as a parent inscription. All BLOCKS inscriptions must be inscribed on their block-matching uncommon sats. For example, this 839020 genesis BLOCKS inscription was inscribed on the Alpha Uncommon sat from the BTC blockHeight 839020 and is a child inscription of 839020.bitmap. All future generations of BLOCKS (1st, 2nd, 3rd generation, etc.) must have valid BLOCKS as parent inscriptions. BLOCKS after the 4th halving block (blockHeight >= 840000) are shown as runic purple blocks because of the native rune data in TXs. BTC block 6929999 will be the maximum blockHeight that can be inscribed for a valid BLOCKS inscription.

Bitcoin Library project aimed at redefining the value of blockchain information storage. By permanently preserving cultural materials on the Bitcoin blockchain, the project facilitates global instant access and provides an innovative solution for the protection and inheritance of cultural heritage.
